underlying_goal: Create a Claude skill that embeds fund account (专户) opening day and redemption timing data from an Excel file, so the user can quickly query whether specific accounts are open on any given day
friction_detail: Initially tried to fetch Tencent Docs URL directly which failed due to dynamic rendering, requiring user to provide local file instead.
brief_summary: User wanted a skill to query fund account opening days from an Excel file; Claude successfully created the skill and answered multiple queries correctly.
